texts.label: תעתיק
texts.citation: Geoffrey Khan, Arabic Legal and Administrative Documents in the Cambridge Genizah Collections (Cambridge: Cambridge University Press, 1993).
texts.html:
Verso, right-hand page

  1. الحمد لله وحده الحمد لله وحده وصلواته على خير خلق من الورى
  2. صلوات الله وبركاته ونوامي زكواته وافضل تحياته على مولانا وسيدنا
  3. الامام المستنصر بالله امير المومنين وعلى ابائه الطاهرين وابنائه الاكرمين 
  4. عبد مولانا صلوات الله عليه يقبل الارض ويضرع في استخدامه

texts.label: תרגום לאנגלית
texts.citation: Geoffrey Khan, Arabic Legal and Administrative Documents in the Cambridge Genizah Collections (Cambridge: Cambridge University Press, 1993).
texts.html:
1. The benedictions of God and his blessings, his increasing benefactions and most excellent greetings be upon our master and lord

  2. the imām al-Mustanṣir bi-Allāh, commander of the faithful, and upon his pure ancestors and most noble sons.

  3. The slave of our master, the blessings of God be upon him, kisses the ground and humbly requests him to employ him.
